microtheory.name: education_pedagogy
microtheory.definition: Education + pedagogy — formal + informal learning, teaching practice, curriculum, assessment, learning theory. Dewey, Vygotsky, Piaget, Freire, Bloom, Papert, Bruner. Foundations of learning + instructional design. Substrate analogue: how knowledge + capability transfer across agents and across time.

concepts.name: education
concepts.definition: Process of facilitating learning. Formal (school) + informal (life). Aimed at knowledge, skill, character, citizenship.

concepts.name: pedagogy
concepts.definition: Practice + theory of teaching. From Greek paidos (child) + agogos (leader). Andragogy = adult learning.

concepts.name: curriculum
concepts.definition: Planned course of study. Explicit + implicit (hidden) + null curriculum. Standards-based vs constructivist.

concepts.name: assessment_education
concepts.definition: Measuring learning. Formative (during, feedback) vs summative (after, evaluation). Validity + reliability.

concepts.name: behaviorism_education
concepts.definition: Skinner. Operant conditioning. Programmed instruction. Direct instruction. Substrate analogue: substrate's reinforcement learning analog.

concepts.name: cognitivism_education
concepts.definition: Information processing. Working memory + schema + cognitive load (Sweller). Substrate analogue: substrate's processing pipeline.

concepts.name: constructivism_education
concepts.definition: Learners actively construct understanding. Piaget developmental + Vygotsky social variants. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-construction.

concepts.name: social_constructivism
concepts.definition: Vygotsky. Learning mediated by social interaction + cultural tools. Substrate analogue: substrate's interaction-mediated formation.

concepts.name: zone_of_proximal_development
concepts.definition: ZPD. Vygotsky. What learner can do with help, not yet alone. Scaffolding here. Substrate analogue: substrate's adjacent-possible learning.

concepts.name: scaffolding_pedagogy
concepts.definition: Wood + Bruner + Ross. Temporary support fading as learner takes over. Substrate analogue: substrate's plasticity-then-stabilization pattern.

concepts.name: experiential_learning_kolb
concepts.definition: Kolb. Concrete experience → reflective observation → abstract conceptualization → active experimentation. Cyclic.

concepts.name: deweys_progressive_education
concepts.definition: John Dewey. Education = life, not preparation for it. Inquiry, democracy, hands-on. 'Experience and Education' 1938.

concepts.name: freire_critical_pedagogy
concepts.definition: Paulo Freire. 'Pedagogy of the Oppressed' 1968. Banking model critique. Dialogue + praxis + conscientization. Education political.

concepts.name: papert_constructionism
concepts.definition: Seymour Papert. Learning by making. Logo + Mindstorms. Microworlds. Substrate analogue: substrate's grounding-by-action principle.

concepts.name: blooms_taxonomy
concepts.definition: Bloom 1956. Cognitive domain: remember → understand → apply → analyze → evaluate → create. Affective + psychomotor variants.

concepts.name: direct_instruction
concepts.definition: Teacher-led explicit teaching. Effective for novices + foundational skills. Engelmann + Rosenshine.

concepts.name: inquiry_based_learning
concepts.definition: Student-driven investigation. Effective when learners have foundation. Higher cognitive load when novice.

concepts.name: problem_based_learning
concepts.definition: Authentic problems drive learning. Medical schools pioneered. Substrate analogue: substrate's task-driven knowledge formation.

concepts.name: project_based_learning
concepts.definition: Extended project produces tangible result. Integrates multiple skills. Modern STEM common.

concepts.name: spaced_repetition
concepts.definition: Review at increasing intervals. Counter forgetting curve (Ebbinghaus). Anki, SuperMemo. Substrate analogue: substrate's consolidation timing.

concepts.name: retrieval_practice
concepts.definition: Testing as learning. Roediger + Karpicke. Active retrieval beats rereading for long-term retention.

concepts.name: interleaving_learning
concepts.definition: Mix topics in study session. Slower in-moment learning + better transfer + retention.

concepts.name: deliberate_practice
concepts.definition: Ericsson. Focused, feedback-rich, error-correcting practice at edge of ability. ~10,000 hours misinterpreted; quality matters.

concepts.name: growth_mindset_education
concepts.definition: Dweck. Believing ability is malleable improves persistence + learning. Substrate analogue: substrate's update_policy=adaptive.

concepts.name: self_efficacy_education
concepts.definition: Bandura. Belief in own ability to succeed. Predicts effort + persistence + outcomes.

concepts.name: stereotype_threat_education
concepts.definition: Steele + Aronson. Awareness of stereotype impairs performance. Affects achievement gaps.

concepts.name: cognitive_load_theory
concepts.definition: Sweller. Working memory limited; instructional design minimises extraneous load + manages intrinsic + supports germane.

concepts.name: formative_assessment
concepts.definition: Feedback during learning. Wiliam: 'minute-by-minute' assessment most powerful. Substrate analogue: substrate's continuous correction signal.

concepts.name: summative_assessment
concepts.definition: End-of-unit evaluation. Grades + certifications + selection. Lower learning impact but high stakes.

concepts.name: standardized_test
concepts.definition: Same format + administration across many. SAT, PISA. Comparability + criticism (cultural bias, narrow construct).

concepts.name: literacy
concepts.definition: Reading + writing competence. Foundation of formal education + opportunity. UNESCO targets.

concepts.name: numeracy
concepts.definition: Mathematical competence in everyday life. Distinct from advanced mathematics.

concepts.name: digital_literacy
concepts.definition: Competence with digital tools + info. Increasingly basic skill.

concepts.name: school_system
concepts.definition: Institutional structure. Primary + secondary + tertiary. Public + private. Comprehensive vs tracked.

concepts.name: homeschooling
concepts.definition: Education outside formal school. Religious + ideological + pedagogical motivations. Growing globally.

concepts.name: online_learning
concepts.definition: MOOCs, LMS, asynchronous + synchronous. COVID accelerated. Engagement + completion challenges.

rules.name: learning_happens_in_zpd
rules.head: Jabberwock designs instruction
rules.body: target the zone of proximal development — challenging but achievable with support. Too easy = no growth; too hard = frustration. Vygotsky.

rules.name: retrieval_beats_rereading
rules.head: Jabberwock chooses study method
rules.body: active retrieval (self-testing) produces better long-term retention than passive rereading. Roediger + Karpicke.

rules.name: spaced_repetition_counters_forgetting
rules.head: Jabberwock plans review schedule
rules.body: review at increasing intervals counters Ebbinghaus forgetting curve. Each successful retrieval extends interval. Substrate's consolidation timing.

rules.name: scaffolding_must_fade
rules.head: Jabberwock provides instructional support
rules.body: scaffolding is temporary; must fade as competence grows. Persistent scaffolding becomes crutch. Wood-Bruner-Ross.

rules.name: deliberate_practice_demands_feedback
rules.head: Jabberwock pursues expertise
rules.body: practice without feedback + error correction plateaus. Ericsson: deliberate practice requires focused effort, real-time feedback, sustained challenge.
